conventions.lines: 1-based; a line ends at \n or \r\n; a final line without a terminator counts
conventions.forms: every question is sent twice: `question` as typed, and `query`, the words a caller would pick (the same text when none were picked)
conventions.was: the id the question had in version 1, when it moved kind
conventions.added: rework-1 for a question that version 1 did not have
conventions.frozen: fixtures/text-search/question-digests.json holds a sha256 per question over its id, kind, question, query, files, parts, stale and checks; tests fail on any difference, so a change to the yardstick is made on purpose with --freeze
conventions.stale: ranges of an older or draft copy that disagrees with the answer; returning them is not an answer
conventions.readable_now: every part has a range in a file of an extension the engine reads today (a fixed list, so H2 does not move the set); false for no-answer questions
conventions.single_source: computed from the query form only: the rarest query token that any readable file holds is held by exactly one (repository analyzer, no stemming, exact copies counted once; readable = an extension the engine reads today)
conventions.parts: every part is one thing a complete answer cites; any one of a part's ranges satisfies it
conventions.files: every path named in any part; `files` is empty exactly for no-answer questions
conventions.range_inside_passage: a range is found when a returned passage has the same path and start_line <= range start and range end <= end_line
conventions.keys: each key occurs, case-folded, in the text of the range's lines joined by newlines
conventions.checks: absent_from_corpus: no file holds the word as a token; absent_from_files: no file of a part's first range holds it as a token (repository analyzer); a later range is an alternative that may hold it

word-form.what: a different form of a word the file holds (plural, tense, inflection)

misspelt.what: a misspelt word; the file holds the right spelling

phrase.what: an exact phrase; its words also occur apart in other files

two-passages.what: the answer spans two passages of one file

filename.what: the question is about the file's name, not its text

no-answer.what: nothing in the folder answers; the right result is nothing

tamil-latin.what: Tamil asked in Latin letters; the file is in Tamil script

synonym.what: another word or a paraphrase for what the file says, not a form of its word

table.what: a row found by one column's value; the answer is another column of that row

current-copy.what: two files disagree; the answer is the current one, the older or draft copy is `stale`

where-is-it.what: the file asked for by its type or role (the spreadsheet with the loans)
